name: Bulgasari
description:
About This Game

You have gained the power of Bulgasari, a monstrous beast that grows stronger by devouring iron, to stand against the oncoming machine horde.

Bulgasari is a multitasking action roguelike where combat and inventory management happen at the same time.

While your left hand fights enemies, your right hand manages a constant stream of incoming enhancement modules. Arrange modules to increase your stats, defeat more enemies, and earn even more modules.

Collect scrap dropped by enemies and trade with the Space Stagecoach for items with powerful and unique effects.

Create a new build every run through different characters, items, and their interactions.

FEATURES

  • Simultaneous Action & Inventory Building

Fight enemies in real time while managing your inventory. Become a master multitasker.

  • Strategic Inventory Management

Your strength depends on how you arrange your modules. Complete lines using matching module types or grades to gain bonuses. Chain line completions together to earn even greater rewards.

  • Feed Your Hunger

Devour the scrap left behind by fallen enemies and grow stronger. Every battle is an opportunity to evolve.

  • Module Shaping

Remove individual blocks from modules and reshape them however you like. Create the exact module you need for your build.

You might need a little luck, though.

  • Trade with the Space Stagecoach

Collect scrap and spend it on new items. Build something different every run.

  • Multiple Playable Characters

Each character offers a different way to play and survive.
short_desc: Bulgasari is a multitasking action roguelike where combat and inventory management happen at the same time. Devour scrap to grow stronger, create your own build, and survive against endless machine hordes.
